rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the physical dimension or measured thickness of an object.

example.english: The thickness of this wooden board is just right.
example.traditional: 呢塊木板嘅厚度啱啱好。
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 muk6 baan2 ge3 hau5 dou6 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2

rows.note: Use this when the English sense means a separate layer of material, especially in expressions such as several layers of cloth.

example.english: The blanket's thickness comes from its three layers of cloth.
example.traditional: 呢張被有三層布，個厚度啱啱好。
example.jyutping: ne1 zoeng1 pei5 jau5 saam1 cang4 bou3 go3 hau5 dou6 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2

rows.note: Use this for the thickness or viscosity of a liquid or mixture, such as cream or sauce.

example.english: The thickness of this sauce is just right for mixing with rice.
example.traditional: 呢個醬汁嘅杰度啱啱好，撈飯最正。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zoeng3 zap1 ge3 git6 dou6 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2 lou1 faan6 zeoi3 zeng3
